column1: # The checks of shell/formset-skip.nsh. See check-shell-log.sh.
# The PASSWORD of each form set that uefisettings ignores could name any variable, so get,
# list-questions and set of a question of a form set after one read and write none, even with

column3: .error_message | startswith("PASSWORD questions of package list 8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000001200 may be in the IFR that uefisettings ignores at offset 118 of a form package: the FormSet 8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000001201, which holds, outside its forms, an op shorter than its minimum, which UEFI 2.11 ") and endswith("; as the variable of that password is unknown, the UEFI Shell build reads and writes no variable of this HiiDB")

.error_message | contains("; PASSWORD questions of package list 8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000001210 may be in the IFR that uefisettings ignores at offset 0 of a form package: the FormSet 8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000001211, which holds, outside its forms, an op shorter than its minimum, which UEFI 2.11 ")
